scope: Add twenty Chemistry and ten Math Medium bilingual question-choice sets without rewriting canonical content, reviewer status, or historical remediation hashes.
reviewStatus: Implementation content screening only; every affected card retains pending editorial review. This amendment records a change history and does not constitute accepted provenance evidence or reviewer approval.
hashMethod: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(card), preserving the committed property order. beforeHash is the exact card at baseCommit; afterHash is the amended card. Removing only fieldsAdded reconstructs the original whole-card fingerprint.
